correctness.rationale: Each codeword creates at most three received pairs. A nondegenerate word corresponds exactly to three edges of a P4 in K_m,n. Explicit covers for the five nontrivial base rectangles (2,2),(2,3),(2,4),(3,3),(4,4), plus transposes and tiled (3,4), are verified. Every 3-by-t rectangle with t>=2 partitions into t P4s by 2/3-column grouping. Splitting off three rows or columns adds precisely n or m words, preserving ceil(m*n/3). A direct standard-library replay checked all 2401 pairs 2<=m,n<=50; induction, not testing, proves unrestricted cases.

value.rationale: This is the natural minimum covering-cardinality invariant for a length-four two-consecutive-deletion channel, with a complete formula for all nontrivial alphabet sizes rather than an isolated census. It resolves the nondivisible-by-three congruence obstruction with provably minimal one/two repeated received pairs, while preserving previously known decomposable cases. Its leading q^2/3 homogeneous-alphabet size improves the leading q^2/2 upper-bound coefficient supplied by the recent general nonbinary construction at the same blocklength, providing explicit optimal codebooks.
